messages:
anne: Quick heads-up — rolling a tiny canary for v2.1-int4 on /chat (0.5% traffic, 30m). Primary goals: concordance delta, p95 latency, and token cost. Will monitor auto-fallback threshold set at 3% concordance regression and 15% p95 latency increase.

jordi: sounds good. which slices are in the watchlist? long-doc, code, and short-qa?

anne: yes — watchlist: long-doc (>1k tokens), code completion, short factual QAs (FAQ style). Also tracking top-10 customer prompts from last 48h.

priya: canary-bot will post early smoke results. FYI I bumped batch_size to 8 for the canary to match live config. That might affect p95 slightly — noted in the ticket.

canary-bot: [smoke] 5m: samples=1200, concordance_delta=-0.9%, p95_latency=210ms (+8%), token_cost=-11% :eyes:

sam: concordance looks fine. p95 up but within our 15% threshold. Do we have per-slice breakdown?

canary-bot: per-slice: long-doc concordance_delta=-2.8%, p95_latency=890ms (+22%) | code concordance_delta=-0.4%, p95_latency=180ms (+5%) | short-qa concordance_delta=+0.2%, p95_latency=160ms (+3%).

anne: long-doc worrisome — it's past the 2% concordance soft-warning we discussed. But the overall canary is still under hard rollback (3%). My recommendation: keep canary running, lower long-doc traffic routed to candidate (from 10% of canary to 2%) and spin a short shadow run for long-doc with v2.1-int4 and v2.1-fp16 to compare.

jordi: agree. set route change and shadow. canary-bot, apply routing tweak: long-doc_split=2%?

canary-bot: routing update applied. long-doc routed to candidate=2% of canary traffic; shadow run enabled for 1000 long-doc samples.

priya: logging note — long-doc KV warmup may be less effective under int4 due to cache alignments. I'll add warmstart tokens for the shadow run to isolate KV-warm behavior.

sam: also flag: the p95 increase for long-doc (+22%) exceeds the 15% latency rollback threshold. If concordance doesn't improve in the shadow comparison, we should auto-fallback. Can we lower the auto-fallback to 12% for this canary?

anne: don't change hard rollback mid-run. We'll wait for the shadow run (10m) then decide. If shadow shows fp16 >> int4 concordance or latency, do immediate rollback.

canary-bot: shadow run (10m) complete: 1000 samples. v2.1-int4 long-doc concordance_delta=-3.1%, p95=915ms (+24%). v2.1-fp16 concordance_delta=-0.6%, p95=720ms (+8%). Delta between variants significant (z-test p<0.01).

priya: that's pretty clear. int4 underperforms on long-doc in both fidelity and latency. I recommend triggering auto-fallback for the candidate and opening a follow-up ticket to investigate quantization kernel (kv alignment + chunking).

anne: agreed — initiating rollback to v2.0-stable for all long-doc traffic and promoting v2.1-int4 holdback. We'll keep v2.1-int4 shadow running for smaller slices and iteratively tune quant params.

jordi: can we capture a small repro set (100 long-docs) and run per-layer activation diffs? Ticket that too.

priya: on it — creating ticket with diffs + nvprof traces. tag: quant-longdoc-investigation.

canary-bot: rollback executed: candidate traffic reverted. Auto-fallback reason: long-doc concordance delta breach + latency breach (see shadow comparison). Incident alert posted to #incidents.

anne: thanks team. Action items: (1) priya + infra: collect traces and run per-layer diffs, (2) ml + eng: try alternate quant config (bias-correction, chunked-kv), (3) jordi: update rollout playbook to include shadow-longdoc step by default for int4 candidates.

sam: +1 to playbook update. Also propose adding a temporary canary metric: longdoc_concordance_weighted so that long-docs count proportionally more in overall delta for future runs.

anne: good idea — file a follow-up for adding weighted metric. Closing this thread after tickets created. :white_check_mark:
